title: The Nameplate
subtitle: The item, not the shape of the item
description: The sexton's fee is a blade with the right name on it, and the
right name is not a matter of taste: `Sexton's Key`, iron, anvil-
work, the parish's oldest key and nobody's sword.
This is what `components` and `match` are for. The task names a
`minecraft:custom_name` component, and `match: fuzzy` asks a carried
stack to have the data the task names rather than to be identical
to it in every other respect. A plain iron sword does not count. A
sword named `Sexton's Key` does, whatever its durability says.
